output.draft: The phone rang at 3 a.m., which is the hour nobody calls with good news. A woman's voice asked for Northstar Investigations by name and said her brother had walked into a building downtown a week ago and never walked back out. The police dismissed it as a Tuesday; she had a checkbook that called it something else. I told her we'd take the case. I didn't tell her what it would take from her.
output.rationale: Compact (under 120 words), punchy noir tone with understated menace ('I didn't tell her what it would take from her'), establishes a clear hook (missing brother case), avoids clichés, and reads as pure narrative with no meta-commentary.
